## [1.5.0](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0) (2026-11-17)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* drop supported version 3.127.0 and 3.128.0

### ✨ New Features

* add Crunchyroll 1080p download quality patch ([462a94a](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/462a94a15f960fd7c3f29f94070f8ec124881ab7))
* add Crunchyroll auto-skip segments patch ([f939ba0](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/f939ba0835b0acc3e5e414137ebb85c6fc5864b9))
* add Crunchyroll manual video quality patch ([4eb26c5](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/4eb26c531379a5530c3a6dafce6afd460b2acfd7))
* drop supported version 3.127.0 and 3.128.0 ([51ff491](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/51ff49197dbf3c27958e9fd2390bb1a9d7542d8f))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* group patches by category ([b0d6f85](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/b0d6f857f98d5cad65c5db2ded636990c2918d4b))
* harden background services and telemetry patches ([615b0b4](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kageroll/commit/615b0b4303e24357e9f4cae54f04bb770319616f))

patches.name: 1080p download quality
patches.description: Upgrades the High offline download quality tier to 1080p and selects the single best matching video track.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE from membership card and Compose dialogs to permit screenshots and disables Android 14+ screen capture detection in the Arc reader.

patches.name: Auto-skip segments
patches.description: Automatically skips intros, recaps, credits, previews, or promos in the video player.

options.description: Automatically skip ending credits (preserves post-credits scenes when present).

patches.name: Disable background services
patches.description: Disables background broadcast receivers, schedulers, widget polling, Firebase sessions initialization and service binding, and DataTransport JobScheduler tasks to eliminate background wakeups and idle battery drain.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Segment initialization, Mux events, advertising ID lookup, Firebase Analytics pre-init, Crashlytics NDK native loading, Braze session and push flush alarms, and Datadog uploads; disables Firebase Analytics after consent updates, denies automatic Crashlytics uploads, and selects disabled Datadog setup.

patches.name: Manual video quality
patches.description: Replaces the preset quality tiers with manual per-resolution selection and Auto.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Unhides the player's speed menu and fills it out to 0.5x-2.0x.

patches.name: Proxy token requests
patches.description: Routes token acquisition and refresh through your SOCKS proxy, with optional proxy authentication.

options.description: Hostname or IP address only, without scheme, credentials, or port. Use brackets for IPv6.
Explicit port from 1 to 65535. Enter as a string when using a JSON options file.
Optional printable ASCII username (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Leave both credential fields blank for no authentication.
Optional printable ASCII password (1–255 characters). Credentials are embedded in the patched APK. Supply both username and password together.
Logs token HTTP status and exception class names only, under MorpheTokenProxy. Enable for troubleshooting.

patches.name: Suppress bloat workers
patches.description: Forces Google Engage, Continue Watching, Datadog, and OneTrust CMP background workers to return success immediately without performing network requests, disk I/O, or image prefetching.
